dataset.description: The dataset contains raw finger-force measurements collected during isometric force-production tasks. It also includes clinical nerve conduction test results from CTS patients and healthy controls.

distribution.title: The purpose is to obtain finger force values to calculate synergies in CTS patients and healthy individuals as well as nerve conduction results. Finger-force synergy metrics will be used to test whether coordinated force-production patterns differ between CTS patients and healthy individuals, and whether these metrics correlate with nerve conduction values. Nerve conduction data provide clinical confirmation of median nerve impairment.

dataset.title: Finger Force and Nerve Conduction Data

dmp.description: This Data Management Plan (DMP) supports a research project focused on developing an early, low-cost diagnostic method for carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS) using measurements of finger synergies and anticipatory synergy adjustments. The project generates quantitative finger force data and clinical assessment information. The DMP outlines how these data will be collected, stored, processed, protected, and shared in a secure, ethical, and transparent manner. Its purpose is to ensure data quality, reproducibility, and long-term preservation while enabling responsible access and reuse of the research data.
dmp.ethical_issues_description: Participants’ clinical data will be collected. It will be pseudonymized to ensure no one can identify the participant.
